notes.title: First sale of 2025 - Lands of Avaronia now 50% off!
notes.notes:
[img][/img][h1][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h1]

This is a quick announcement that Lands of Avaronia is now on sale and the game now [u][b]costs only 0.50$![/b][/u]

As a solo-dev this whole project was a huge learning process for me both in terms of game development and marketing. I have learned the basics of game publishment on Steam and everything that surrounds releasing a game to the masses. Because of that I would to thank every single one of you for trying out Lands of Avaronia and giving me some honest feedback.

Stay tuned for new projects from my side - this time I have way more experience especially when it comes to game development but also, as mentioned early, in regards to the marketing of my products.

Lands of Avaronia [u][b]sale is available from 20th to 27th of January.[/b][/u]

Hope you enjoy!
